exposure: Prelabor cesarean delivery on maternal request (CS)
outcome: Protein modules correlated with duration from rupture of membranes to full dilation of the cervix
Metabolic module in cord blood correlated with VD

Biological function of identified modules (e.g., actin cytoskeleton, C21 steroids, steroid sulfates, oxysterols, NADP metabolic process, nicotinate, and nicotinamide metabolism, steroid hormone biosynthesis pathway)
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women, consisting of 16 spontaneous onset vaginal delivery, 16 prelabor cesarean delivery on maternal request, and 8 intrapartum cesarean section women.
finding: Differences in steroid hormones and the actin cytoskeleton pathway identified through proteomics and metabolomics in amniotic fluid and cord blood were more indicative of the labor process.
mod_finding: Compared to the prelabor CS group, proteomic and metabolomic profiles were similar between the Intra_CS and VD groups, and a metabolic module in cord blood correlated with VD was enriched in C21 steroids, steroid sulfates, and oxysterols.
followup_time: At birth (amniotic fluid and cord blood samples)
